Signals to watch: peer-reviewed sensor densification demonstrations, warning logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting phone alerts uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Simulates Earthquake Early Warning 2.0 operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where sensor densification monitoring, warning logistics redundancy, or phone alerts maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Earthquake Early Warning 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Earthquake Early Warning 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Earthquake Early Warning 2.0 — next-gen seconds-before shaking alerts.

Phase 1 — Prove (sensor densification): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (warning logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (phone alerts): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (automated shutdown): warning hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and seismic zones-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
